🇩🇿 Algerian rai music is one of Algeria's most iconic musical genres. It was born in the city of Oran, in western Algeria, during the early 20th century. Emerging from traditional Bedouin and folk songs performed by local singers, Raï gradually evolved by blending its rich heritage with modern instruments and rhythms. Its lyrics express everyday life, love, freedom, migration, and social issues, giving a voice to ordinary people. Thanks to the success of many Algerian artists, Raï music gained international recognition while proudly preserving its authentic Algerian identity and cultural roots. #algeria #rai #music #trending #fyp
